model_annotation: This graphic presents three donut charts that depict the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover across four sectors: industry, construction, trade, and other services, in 2021. Each chart is divided into four sections. The chart for the number of enterprises has sections labeled industry, brown, 8%, 2.4 million; construction, blue, 12%, 3.7 million; trade, red, 19%, 5.9 million; and other services, dark blue, 61%, 19.0 million. The chart for the number of persons employed has sections labeled industry, brown, 21%, 33.0 million; construction, blue, 9%, 13.4 million; trade, red, 19%, 29.5 million; and other services, dark blue, 51%, 80.2 million. The chart for turnover has sections labeled industry, brown, 33%, 10.6 trillion; construction, blue, 6%, 1.9 trillion; trade, red, 31%, 9.9 trillion; and other services, dark blue, 31%, 9.8 trillion. The charts include legends that show the color for each sector, and the chart for turnover includes percentage values displayed inside each section.
